name: Podcast audio
description: Check, clean up and prepare podcast audio. The check measures loudness (LUFS), true peak, range, silences, channels, sample rate and bit rate against podcast norms (-16 LUFS stereo, -19 mono, true peak under -1 dBTP) and reports problems with the second they occur. Normalise brings the loudness to -16 LUFS in two passes without clipping; Clean adds a high-pass, noise reduction and light compression first; Trim cuts the silence at both ends and shortens long pauses; Chapters lists the pauses of 3 seconds or more as candidate chapter points; Tag sets the title, artist and album without re-encoding. The original is never changed. Transcripts and show notes: the Whisper tool (Transcribe to SRT). Conversions: the ffmpeg tool.

presets.label: Check (loudness, peaks, silences, format)
presets.description: Measures the episode against podcast norms: integrated loudness (-16 LUFS stereo, -19 mono, give or take 2), true peak (under -1 dBTP), loudness range, leading and trailing silence, long pauses, sample rate and bit rate. Problems come back as file(second), with Fix with agent.

presets.label: Chapters (pauses as candidate chapter points)
presets.description: Lists every pause of 3 seconds or more with its time: a start for chapter markers and show notes. Add the titles from the transcript.

presets.label: Normalise loudness to the podcast level (MP3)
presets.description: Two-pass loudness normalisation to the podcast level (-16 LUFS for stereo, -19 for mono, the same levels the check expects) with a true-peak ceiling of -1.5 dB, to MP3 (96 kbit/s mono, 128 stereo, 44.1 kHz).

presets.label: Normalise loudness to the podcast level (M4A / AAC)
presets.description: The same, to AAC in an .m4a file (what Apple Podcasts likes).

presets.label: Clean up the voice (MP3)
presets.description: High-pass at 80 Hz (rumble), noise reduction, light compression, then loudness to -16 LUFS. One pass, for a quick improvement of a raw recording.

presets.label: Trim silence (MP3)
presets.description: Cuts the silence at both ends and shortens every pause longer than 2 seconds to 0.8 seconds.

presets.label: Set the tags (MP3)
presets.description: Type the tags in the extra arguments: title=Episode 12;artist=Dario;album=My Show (also date, year, comment, genre, track, composer, description). The audio is copied, not re-encoded.
